name: ShifuBot
author: github.com/MarkVebeer
description: ShifuBot: an open source Discord bot with a web dashboard, built with Bun. The bot and the dashboard run in one process on the server's allocation port. Put a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front of the allocation and set PUBLIC_URL to that address.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ShifuBot installation script
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -e

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null

REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/MarkVebeer/shifu-bot.git}"
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Updating existing ShifuBot checkout from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
    git remote set-url origin "${REPO}"
    git fetch --depth 1 origin "${BRANCH}"
    git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH}"
else
    echo "Cloning ShifuBot from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
    rm -rf /tmp/shifubot
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${REPO}" /tmp/shifubot
    cp -a /tmp/shifubot/. /mnt/server/
    rm -rf /tmp/shifubot
fi

# The data folder holds the SQLite database. It is git ignored, so updates never touch it.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data

echo "Installing dependencies"
bun install --frozen-lockfile

echo "Building the dashboard"
bun run build

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "ShifuBot installation completed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Developer Portal > your application > Bot > Reset Token. Keep it secret.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: Developer Portal > your application > General Information > Application ID.

variables.name: Discord Client Secret
variables.description: Developer Portal > your application > OAuth2 > Client Secret. Used for dashboard login.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The address people use to open the dashboard, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://shifu.example.com. Add PUBLIC_URL/auth/callback as an OAuth2 redirect in the Developer Portal.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: A long random string (at least 32 characters) used to sign login cookies. Changing it signs everyone out.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: How much the bot logs: trace, debug, info, warn or error.

variables.name: Default Language
variables.description: Language for newly added servers: en (English) or hu (Hungarian). Each server can change it in the dashboard.

variables.name: Database Path
variables.description: Where the SQLite database is stored, relative to the server folder. Keep it inside the data folder.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Repository the installer clones. Change it only if you run a fork.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch the installer clones and updates from.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Trust the X-Forwarded-* headers of your reverse proxy. Use false when people connect straight to the allocation port without a proxy. With true, the port must only be reachable through the proxy, otherwise anyone can fake these headers and dodge the rate limit.

variables.name: Trusted Proxy Hops
variables.description: How many reverse proxies are in front of ShifuBot. Use 2 for Cloudflare + nginx. A value that is too low makes all visitors share one rate limit.
